name: bZx iETH self-transfer duplication
summary: LoanTokenLogic's _internalTransferFrom cached the sender and receiver balances before writing them and never rejected _from == _to, so each self-transfer of iETH credited the receiver without debiting the sender and doubled the attacker's iETH before burnToEther().
notes: setTarget(address) selected LoanTokenLogicWeth 0xde744d544a9d768e96c21b5f087fc54b776e9b25 in the iETH proxy's custom target_ slot.

The approximately $8.1 million gross campaign loss covers the reported LINK, ETH, USDT, USDC, and DAI drained through duplicated iToken balances. The attacker later returned the assets; recovery is separate from exploit-time gross loss.
The $8.1 million USD value is a reputable reported campaign total rather than a transaction-by-transaction incident-time valuation; the later full recovery is recorded separately from gross loss.
